description: This file defines a class called Constants containing application-wide constant values used throughout an Android project related to tourist attractions. It includes configuration flags, timeout values, messaging strings, image size parameters, notification IDs, intent extra keys, and API paths.

classes.name: Constants
classes.description: A utility class that holds various static final fields used for configuration, intent extras, notification IDs, URLs, and other constants across the application.

methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the Constants class.
